entries.14635a602c90a08c: This business provides real estate sales brokerage, leasing of its own developed properties and condominiums developed by other companies, proposals for effective use of real estate, leasing management and condominium management, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥595 million. Consignment sales of sale properties, leasing management and condominium management are handled by consolidated subsidiary Urbanet Living Co., Ltd.
entries.1b27fbcfc206d590: This business operates the company-owned hotel 'Hotel Ajīru Tokyo Kamata', with 48 rooms in total, in front of Kamata Station in Tokyo. It opened in October 2020; it is owned by the company for the purpose of accumulating know-how in hotel development and operation, and operations are handled by consolidated subsidiary Urbanet Living Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥237 million.

entries.71e2d990aab73c7f: A real estate company that develops urban rental apartments near stations in Tokyo's 23 wards and sells them as 1 whole building.
entries.bf644a75d44a079a: This business acquires business sites and creates business plans that maximize profitability through plan design and income simulation, which it then develops and sells. For the fiscal year ended June 2026, revenue was ¥38,025 million, from sales of 12 urban rental condominium buildings with 541 units, 52 detached house and townhouse units, and 13 land parcels, among others. It differentiates itself through monotone exterior designs and entrances displaying original artworks, among other features.
